lines.speaker: Una
lines.text: There is a battlefield not far from here that runs red with rust, where the weapons and armour of countless Ezomytes still remain... We call it the Red Vale. You should search the area. There may still be power in some of those centuries old relics. Renly will know how to forge them. Bring the runes to him, and then, perhaps, we shall find some answers.

lines.speaker: Una
lines.text: I see you've already found the vale, and some of the runes we need. But I don't think they will be enough. Return to the vale and search for more. Renly will know how to forge them.

lines.speaker: Una
lines.text: I see you've already found relics with the runes we need. What luck! The First Ones are truly watching over us. Renly will know how to forge them. Bring what you've gathered to him, and then, perhaps, we shall find some answers.
